title: EBC 912: Energy Conservation
officialText:
912.1 Minimum requirements.

Level 2 alterations to existing buildings or structures are permitted without requiring the entire building or structure to comply with the energy requirements of the New York City Energy Conservation Code. Level 2 alterations shall conform to the energy requirements of Chapters R5 or C5 of the New York City Energy Conservation Code , as applicable.
